Subject: Q2 customer health snapshot + priority escalation log (Polaris HealthTech)

Team / Mia,

Attached is a short pre-read for our QBR prep next week. High level asks below — please flag anything you want added to the executive log: 

- Confirm the top 3 platform incidents impacting Polaris (severity + customer-visible impact)
- Provide the latest RL (regional latency) numbers for east-us and eu-west (last 30 days)
- Any open procurement blockers for the renewal (contracts/procurement contacts)

Mia — could you confirm whether the Polaris engineering ops team will join the technical breakouts on Tuesday? If they can, please include the best contact (eng-ops@polarishealthtech.com works) and any escalation contacts for procurement.

I've included an initial "Priority Escalation Log" page in the deck (attached) that rolls up risks and current mitigation owners. We'll review during the leadership 30-min pre-brief.

Thanks,
Hannah

Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — got the deck and read through. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Engineering ops will join the technical breakout on Tue 4/17 at 14:00 PT. 
- Top incidents last quarter: two brief model-serving throttles (Apr 2, Mar 8) that increased tail latency; both were mitigated with auto-scaling but caused retry storms for our ingestion pipeline. I'll send the incident IDs.
- Procurement: we are working through a legal review on the new DPA language; procurement lead is Sarah Kim (sarah.kim@polarishealthtech.com). Timeline looks like mid-May unless legal asks push it.

I've attached a small export of recent health metrics for your narrow review. Happy to walk through any specific rows during the breakouts.

—Mia

Head of Data Platforms
Polaris HealthTech

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 customer health snapshot + priority escalation log (Polaris HealthTech)

Adding a short risk register update before we meet: 

1) Latency tail spikes — root cause: bursty request patterns + cold-quantized model refill. Owner: infra team (Marissa). Mitigation: pre-warm KV caches for known heavy prefixes; suggestion to enable small windowed batch warmups for Polaris traffic. Impact: renewal risk = medium (customer raised as a concern).

2) Data residency question for eu-west workloads — legal/infra sync required. Owner: legal + platform. Impact: medium-high if Polaris pushes EU workloads to on-prem.

3) Procurement timeline slipping due to DPA redlines. Owner: Jordan / Legal. Ask: recommend a short executive sign-off from our side to prioritize legal review (we can escalate if necessary).

I've added these to the Priority Escalation Log slide and included proposed owners and ask lines. Suggested pre-brief agenda: 1) Quick health signal (5m) 2) Top 3 risks & owners (10m) 3) Tactical asks + executive approvals (10m) 4) Scheduling follow-ups (5m).

Grace
Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 customer health snapshot + priority escalation log (Polaris HealthTech)

Quick technical note on the latency mitigation work: 

- I've validated a small change to the KV cache eviction policy that reduces cold-start tokenization delays for quantized weights. Preliminary bench: 18% tail-latency improvement for sequences >512 tokens on g4dn instances.
- Plan: enable targeted pre-warm for Polaris (canary) for one week prior to the QBR; monitor error rates and cost delta. Estimated incremental cost: ~3% token cost increase during warm period.

I'll add a one-slide tech appendix to the deck (SLA-variance-analysis.xlsx referenced). If leadership wants to sign off on the canary, I can schedule the rollout for Wed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA-variance-analysis.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 16:21:00 -07:00

TL;DR: agree to greenlight a one-week canary for Polaris with exec oversight. 

Hannah / Grace — I can sign off on the technical canary and take the procurement escalation to legal. Action items before the pre-brief: 
- Hannah: update the exec slide with the ask (one-line ask + expected cost delta).
- Marissa: schedule canary rollout window (Wed 04/18 -> Wed 04/25) and post a short monitoring playbook (what metrics to watch + rollback criteria).
- Grace: coordinate with Legal to prioritize Polaris DPA redlines — loop me in if they push back.

If we get these in place, we should be ready to show mitigation progress during the QBR and reduce renewal friction. I'll be on the pre-brief Tuesday at 11:30 PT.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
